artifact_inventory.description: Standalone exact recurrence, binomial-sum, Casoratian, and high-precision asymptotic verification for the AESZ no. 28 sequences.
Deterministic output of verify.py giving the two predicted constants and scaled convergence diagnostics.

limitations: Scientific rejection is for originality and value, not correctness. The result concerns only AESZ no. 28 and does not improve an irrationality measure for \(\zeta(3)\).
provenance: Scientific record; fresh independent scientific assessment completed on 2026-10-01 UTC.
record_title: Sharp exponential constant for the AESZ 28 Apéry limit
scientific_context: For the AESZ no. 28 recurrence with Apéry limit \(C_n/A_n\to\zeta(3)/7\), this record determines the leading asymptotic of \(A_n\) and the leading exponential quotient-error constant.
